verdict: Known conditional diagonal/FiLM and CP composition; a narrow supervised relation-evidence regularization hypothesis remains plausible; distinct label-directed diversification and predictive superiority are unestablished.
strongest_quality_hypothesis: A shared typed representation plus one learned relation/channel tradeoff can retain competent private nonlinear HGT trajectories while regularizing their use of partly redundant relation evidence. Full c updates may improve member placement along that tradeoff. This is conditional and empirical.
required_conditions: The task has label-relevant variation in relation evidence reliability.
The restricted adapter retains member competence.
Private nonlinear responses affect the served mean-logit predictor beneficially.
quality_limits: The residual is rank one across member/relation/channel per layer and static across nodes.
Ordinary own CE does not enforce complementary correct-label explanations or errors.
More profile/spread/rank change alone is not served-quality evidence.
Existing heterogeneous ensembles already use views, supervised fusion and correlation objectives; no numerical benefit transfers.
c_controls_identify: Utility of coordinate-specific c update permission under declared AdamW relative to common-gradient and frozen initial c policies.
c_controls_do_not_identify: Necessity of the whole learned member-by-relation interaction: q/u learn in all three arms.
Pure common component: common versus frozen also differs in decay.
Causal useful diversity or general superiority to heterogeneous ensembles.

single_next_direction.action: Sharpen the existing proposal around supervised relation-evidence regularization; retain its existing arms and pool/own/Jensen/competence accounting.
single_next_direction.practical_result: Improved served mean-logit NLL with retained member competence.
single_next_direction.falsifier: Active profile motion/interaction without served-quality gain rejects this quality hypothesis. A gain consistent with common adapter or member-quality change leaves useful-diversity attribution unresolved.
